thread:
olivia: kicking off the Datadog + OTLP heatmap demo sprint — goal: interactive trace heatmap and dashboards for GPU inference patterns
liam: love it. is this weekend's availability okay for a dry run?
maya: putting together the list of demo probes and sample workloads, will post in a sec
sam: can we highlight prefix KV cache hotspots too? that's usually the trickiest part :thinking_face:
olivia: yes, we should. primary signals: span latency, mem usage, kv cache hit/miss, and model variant fallback counts
jordan: fyi i spun up a small staging cluster with otel-collector + dd-agent on gke, endpoint: https://staging-telemetry.redwood.example/collector
devops-bot: deploy succeeded — staging/otlp-collector v1.4.2 rolled to cluster-alpha :white_check_mark:
maya: pasted sample trace export config:
```
exporters:
  datadog:
    api_key: ${DD_API_KEY}
    endpoint: https://api.datadoghq.com
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
```
liam: thanks. for the dashboard tile i want a heatmap of span.duration over model.sequence_length by gpu_id — Datadog query help:
```
avg:trace.span.duration{service:inference} by {gpu_id,sequence_length}
``` 
olivia: suggestion: also show a small timeseries below for kv_cache_hit_rate to correlate
sam: i've got a notebook that synthesizes traces for 1k/5k/15k seq lengths — will push test data
jordan: can someone own the runbook for the live demo? steps, rollback, support contacts
olivia: i'll own runbook + slide notes. sam — can you be on standby for data injection? liam — dashboard builder?
sam: yep, i'll be on standby at 10:30 PT
liam: i can build & test the dashboard today, will share template JSON by EOD
maya: quick ask — are we doing a joint blog/press with Datadog? that affects screenshots (no company-sensitive telemetry)
jordan: tentative go for joint announcement. legal asked for sanitized screenshots, so use synthetic traces for public assets
olivia: ok noted. next actions: liam dashboard template, sam load scripts, maya demo probes list, jordan confirm Datadog contact for co-announce
liam: tagging @mike-dd (Datadog) in the partner thread now
mike-dd: (in partner thread) happy to collab. can we get a sample JSON for the dashboard? we'll adapt for our tile
olivia: perfect — once liam shares template i'll coordinate with Datadog for final acceptance
sam: smoke test plan: inject 10k traces, validate heatmap variance, ensure no PII, capture perf traces
devops-bot: incident alert muted for this window (10:00-11:30 PT)
olivia: thanks everyone. i'll update the runbook doc and drop link here when ready :rocket:
